IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Thursday, October 8, 2026**

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** is thick with volume—115 calls across Miller and Inglett & Stubbs, all chasing QTS data center builds in Fayetteville at **$42/hr**. That's consistent work with real GF oversight (Tommy Jett running Inglett crews), but the board's stacked at 739 hands deep. Move quick if you're going.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** is screaming. Fifty-six calls, 265 hands, and Gurtz Electric's reposting Port Washington data center work at **$60.00/hr**—that's JW wage plus a **$10/hr base increase** and 60-hour minimums. Cupertino's right there with the same bump. ASAP starts across the board. This is where the premium work is landing.

**LU-474 Memphis, TN** has Cache Valley Electric running 148 hands across two identical Memphis data center calls at **$37.99/hr** plus **$15.00/hr per diem** over scale—that's real money. ArchKey Sachs is pulling 90 hands into Google West Memphis at **$250/day incentive** for full shifts, 6/10s, 6am starts. Arkansas license required. Book's thin at 276 hands; you'll get on.

**LU-611 Albuquerque, NM** sits on 11 calls, 146 hands. Triad's Los Alamos National Labs maintenance work pays **$48.47/hr**, with construction bumped to **$49.57**—94 hands tied up there alone. Cupertino's Facebook data center at **$42.2/hr** runs 5/10s off an 5/8 schedule with OT possible.

**LU-683 Columbus, OH** is tight but hot: Eagle and TSG at EDGED Data Center New Albany showing **$73.42/hr**, 5-10s plus 2-8s with **all OT paid double**. Only 70 hands on the board. Must work M-F minimum.

**LU-602 Amarillo, TX** has Rosendin and Cache Valley pulling 40 hands into Claude, TX at **$52.3/hr** with **$40/day zone pay**, double-time OT structures (60/60/50 breakdown), reporting to Llano.

Data centers are eating the market—Port Washington, Fayetteville, Memphis, Albuquerque, and Columbus all running hot simultaneously. The premium's in the Midwest and on the coasts; if you're chasing scale and hours, that's where the hands are flowing.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Thursday, October 8, 2026**

**LU-1393 Indianapolis, IN** is running heavy with 35 calls and only 56 hands on the board — Book 1 is moving. MJ Electric's got 345kv lattice tower work in Ft. Wayne at **$56.66/hr** plus **$100/day per diem** (or $175 without housing), but they want proven 345kv experience and a CDL A. Same contractor's running a transmission gig at Winimac on a 954/Bundle circuit at the same rate, though that one needs 50-ton crane cert. AMPP Construction has distribution work for AEP property at **$56.66/hr**, which is solid inside JW work. This board's got depth and real transmission meat.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** sits at 16 calls with 45 hands waiting. Parsons Electric's Polaris Forge data center in Harwood is the volume play — 17 hands at **$44.80/hr**, 6-10s, with **$100/day non-taxed per diem Mon-Fri and $150 Sat/Sun**. Michels Power's compressor station in St. Vincent pays the same rate but bumps per diem to **$200/day**. These data-center and industrial projects are sticky — you're looking at months, not weeks.

**LU-474 Memphis, TN** has 6 calls chasing 134 hands, but the scale is legit: Cache Valley and ArchKey are both pegging **$38.25/hr** on Memphis data-center work with day shifts and 6-10 schedules. Gephart's also in at **$38.25/hr** running 4-12s and 2-10s. Per diem ranges from **$15/hr over scale** to **$250/day incentive**. Book is deep; you're waiting.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** has 22 calls and 77 hands — a real board. FAITH ELECTRIC's running College Park/Columbus/Sardis lineman work at **$49.80/hr** (that's **$3 above JL scale**) with **$150/day per diem** and hotels provided. SERVICE ELECTRIC's GTC energized project at Social Circle pays **$46.80/hr**, 11 on/3 off — storm-restoration rhythm.

**LU-602 Amarillo, TX** has tight volume (6 calls, 48 hands) but the money's there. Rosendin and Cache Valley are both running the Llano Project at **$52.30/hr**, **$40/day zone pay**, double-time OT, 60/60/50 hours. Report in 5 and 6 a.m. — this is full-bore industrial install.

Data-center and transmission builds are absorbing the board; layoff season hasn't hit yet, but the hands are chasing infrastructure and power-stack work over storm.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Thursday, October 8, 2026**

**LU-776 Lima, OH** is the board to watch this week — 6 calls, 35 hands needed, and the deepest bench in the mix. Gem's got two separate calls: 13 slots on combo welders at the Fab Shop (test required; incentives stack on top), and 6 pipefitter slots at BDO also reporting to the fab shop (DISA currency mandatory, no beard policy). Graham's Cenovus Maintenance gig is burning through pipefitters on a 6-10 schedule with spotty OT — must be current ticket. Nooter rounds it out with 5 pipefitter slots in the Cenovus fab shop, offering **$125/day per diem** plus incentive pay, but DISA current and beard restrictions apply. Gem's special welding incentives are worth digging into.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** sits at 6 calls, 27 hands open — solid secondary market. US Eng. Metalworks needs 14 fitters with stainless steel experience in a shop setting. Power Source Services is running 5 combo welders with rigging cert or rigging experience at the JM Shafer station in Fort Lupton. Trautman and Shreve's splitting 3 combo welders (MIG/TIG qualified) between day shift (1 slot) and swing (2 slots) at a fab shop. Murphy's Corden Pharma job in Boulder is running 3 fitters with strong layout skills, offering **$125/day per diem** for anyone outside 100 miles, plus 15% incentive pay.

**LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** has just 1 call but it's worth the mention: PMI's hiring a UA-21 Welder at Fort Meade VA Hospital in Sturgis, South Dakota, running **$100/day per diem** for days worked. OSHA10 and pass back required.

Work's consolidating around fab shops and maintenance — not chasing new plant starts like spring.
